decisions.executionNote: Cards read 5 and 2. Begin elbow-up approach to left red for five presses; close left gripper. Will follow red0, confirm, red1, confirm sequence.
Continue raised elbow-up arc and turn closed left fingers downward, stopping above red0 before any press.
Finish vertical alignment above left red and settle to check wrist centering; no press yet.
Left red press 1 of 5: centered vertical descent to contact depth, then brief hold. Keep right arm parked.
Release left red fully, then perform press 2 of 5 at the same centered contact depth.
Release and perform left red press 3 of 5; retain centered vertical stroke and full clearance between presses.
Left red press 4 of 5: fully release upward and press once to the same contact height.
Left red press 5 of 5 after full release. This is the last intended red0 press; next lift away for first blue confirmation.
Release red0 after five strokes. Begin right-arm elbow-up approach toward blue for first confirmation, keeping left clear.
Continue right approach above blue with downward finger orientation; no contact yet. Left stays clear of red0.
Align right closed fingers vertically over blue, settle at safe pre-press height and inspect centering before confirmation.
Press blue once to confirm the five left-red strokes, then lift to release. Do not press either red during this confirmation.
Fully release blue and move right arm outward for clearance. Shift left above center red1 without descending; prepare its two presses.
Settle left over center red1 and lower only to a safe pre-contact height. Wrist centering looked slightly offset during transit, so inspect before first press.
Center red1 is now centered in wrist view. Perform its first of two presses, pause at contact depth, and lift fully to release.
Settle at full release, then perform center red1 press 2 of 2 and begin lifting. No more red presses intended after this stroke.
Fully release red1 and withdraw left toward its own workspace. Bring right back above blue at clearance for the second confirmation.
Settle right above blue and verify alignment before second confirmation. Retract left along a raised elbow-up path away from the buttons.
Second blue confirmation after two center-red strokes. One deliberate downstroke and release; then return both arms to origin.
Release blue fully and return both arms toward their origins with raised elbow-up paths. Open grippers only after clearing the buttons.
Continue smooth return to origin with both arms in their own workspaces and open grippers. Slow down near the left home configuration.
